messages:
anya: FYI onboarding of "mistral-slim-v1" hit weird regression after quant run.
dmitri: what failed?
anya: generation drift for prompts that include special tokens like <|SYSTEM|>. Lots of outputs missing the system preamble.
sam: did convert tool preserve chat_template in config.json?
anya: checked, convert log shows "chat_template": null after conversion.
convert-bot: Converted model mistral-slim-v1 @rev=abcdef -> redwood model mistral-slim-v1-rw; warnings: removed unknown fields: chat_template
lina: that sounds like a key rename bug in converter. We recently landed weight_key rename mapping, could accidentally drop chat_template when normalizing.
dmitri: also seeing tokenizer.vocab_size changed and unk id remapped after quant. snippet:
```
TokenMismatchError: special token id 2 != expected 1 for <|SYSTEM|>
```
anya: hub download had intermittent 401 earlier, but final export succeeded. Maybe partial shard fetch changed special_tokens_map order.
sam: did you try re-running convert with --keep-config ?
anya: yes, --keep-config preserved top-level config but chat_template field still empty.
lina: can you paste first 20 lines of config.json from the converted artifact?
anya: pasted (short):
{"model_type":"mistral","special_tokens_map":{"eos_token":"</s>"},"chat_template":""}
dmitri: looks like special_tokens_map lost entries for system/user. HF original had {"system_token":"<|SYSTEM|>","user_token":"<|USER|>"}.
eval-bot: Quick eval: quant int8 run 10k prompts -> Rouge-L drop 6.3% vs fp16 baseline.
sam: interesting, baseline quantization didn't change logits shapes but remapping of special tokens would obviously break chat formatting.
lina: probable cause: converter canonicalizes field names and a recent rename from "system_token"->"special_system_token" in our mapping omitted unknown keys instead of copying them.
anya: repro steps:
1) hf download rev abcdef (had 403 intermittently)
2) converter --format redwood --quant int8 --revpin abcdef
3) deploy -> missing system prompt, lots of hallucination.
dmitri: temporary mitigation: patch converter to fallback to original config keys if normalized keys missing. I'll open PR.
sam: also add E2E test: run tokenizer roundtrip for special tokens and check chat_template is non-empty after convert.
anya: opened ticket RW-3421 with logs and eval chart: https://redwood.tools/issue/RW-3421
convert-bot: Conversion job 2325007890 completed with warnings, artifacts at s3://redwood-convert/mistral-slim-v1/abcdef/
lina: assign to @dmitri and @dana for converter + hub auth investigation.
dana: I can look at hub auth, we saw token refresh race causing partial file writes (tempfile reuse) last week.
anya: thanks, blocking release for now. :thumbsup:
